A [[human]] '''hotel clerk''' with light skin, [[color|brown]] [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s worked at a [[Palmo Plaza hotel]] on the [[Palmo Plaza]] on [[Ghorman]]. In [[3 BBY]], they were working when [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] checked into the hotel under the alias "Ronnie Goo-jah" from [[Mid-Rim News]]. While working they wore a green [[clothing|uniform]] consisting of a green [[jacket]], green vest with gold bands and a white shirt with a tall white collar over a black band decorated with gold bands.<ref name="Messenger" />

==Behind the scenes==
The hotel clerk appeared in the [[Messenger|seventh episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Messenger" /> on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The clerk was portrayed by [[Anne-Sophie Marie]] and was listed in the series' credits as simply "Hotel Clerk".<ref name="Messenger" />
